items.question: How can I pay my bill or manage my account?
items.answer: Use the Account and Billing section to review payment options, manage common account tasks, or find help. For personal assistance, call NW Natural customer service at 800-422-4012.

items.question: How do I start, stop, or transfer natural gas service?
items.answer: Use the Start, Stop or Transfer page and have the current or new service address, preferred effective date, account details, and access instructions ready. If the online path does not fit your situation, call customer service at 800-422-4012.

items.question: What should I do if I smell natural gas?
items.answer: Leave the building or area immediately. Do not operate lights, switches, phones, appliances, matches, or flames near the suspected leak. From a safe location, call NW Natural at 800-882-3377 or call 911, and do not return until responders say it is safe.
